_about: Who sounds like what. Each friend has a list of voices: the first one that works on the free plan is used. Changing the list remakes that friend's clips.

elevenlabs._voices: voice_ids read the letters, sounds and words (standard Arabic). chat_voice_ids (optional) are Egyptian voices made with ElevenLabs Voice Design, used for everything the friends chat. Voice IDs from elevenlabs.io > Voices. Voices from the Voice Library usually need a paid plan, so built-in voices are listed. Toota must only ever get women's or girls' voices.

_pronounce: If a clip sounds wrong (for example a single sound read as a letter name), add the text here with a spelling that reads better, then remake it.
